issues: wordmark 是 translateX −70→0 + blur 横向扫出，卡片 md 自己标注为待改项（应逐字由大变小落位）
背景是死平的 G.bg 灰，图标悬在空中没有任何接地感，晃动与翻扁看不出重量
花形 mark 是五片平涂 teal 椭圆，没有体积和受光
字体回落到 Helvetica 700、字距外放；mark 让位 −420px 后 lockup 整组偏左约 50px
changes: wordmark 改为逐字由大变小落位：scale 1.9→1 + blur 14→0 联动（snappy 12f），原点钉基线，错峰 2.2→2.6f 让每字的落位读得清（md 同步去掉待改项）
背景换柔光 Backdrop（顶部主光 + 一抹 teal 余光 + 暗角 + 颗粒）；图标下方加接地软影，随晃动偏移、翻扁时收窄，绽放后淡去
花瓣改为沿长轴的三段渐变（瓣根深、瓣尖亮）+ 0.5px 白色高光边，花心加细亮边；anticipation、翻扁、spring 绽放的参数全部保持原值
字标换系统字体 650 重、−0.035em 字距；mark 让位改 −350px、字标起点 mark+200，整组视觉居中（md 同步）
补导出 ICON_FLIP_BLOOM_LOGO_DURATION=130，字标 f104 落定后 hold 约 26f
issuesEn: The wordmark swept in with translateX −70→0 plus blur, which the card md itself flagged as a to-do (letters should land big-to-small one by one)
The background was flat G.bg grey and the icon floated with no grounding, so the wobble and flip had no weight
The flower mark was five flat teal ellipses with no volume or light
The font fell back to Helvetica 700 with loose tracking, and after the −420px shift the lockup sat about 50px left of centre
changesEn: Wordmark letters now land big-to-small: scale 1.9→1 with blur 14→0 (snappy, 12f), origin pinned to the baseline, stagger widened 2.2→2.6f so each landing reads (md to-do removed)
Background is a soft-light Backdrop (top key light, a hint of teal, vignette, grain); a grounding contact shadow under the icon shifts with the wobble, narrows with the flip and fades after the bloom
Petals have a three-stop gradient along their length (dark root, bright tip) plus a 0.5px white rim, and the centre gets a fine bright edge; anticipation, flip and spring bloom values unchanged
Wordmark in the system font at 650 weight with −0.035em tracking; mark shift −350px with the word starting at mark+200, so the lockup is optically centred (md updated)
Added ICON_FLIP_BLOOM_LOGO_DURATION=130; the wordmark settles at f104 and holds about 26f
